Current context keeps at most %1$d messages

Caps how many recent messages are sent to the model. When the limit is exceeded, the context is trimmed down to about half in one step instead of dropping one message per turn, so the request prefix stays stable and prompt caching keeps working for many turns. The minimum is 20. Leave blank for unlimited.
The prompt cache is invalidated each time the context is trimmed. A larger limit means less frequent trimming.
